name: no-extension
purpose: the no-extension path: pipelines with no slots, the same route through the core as any other. No default is chosen by it; it is written out

name: scopes-inbound-retained
purpose: the approved api-server under one traffic scope and one retention and export scope: inbound on 8443, plaintext retained on the host, nothing exported

name: scopes-outbound-exported
purpose: the SAME approved api-server, the same observation scope, under a different traffic scope and a different retention and export scope: outbound to 443, no plaintext retained, connection records exported. The three controls move independently

name: content-filter-is-not-approval
purpose: the observation scope selects api-server and excludes curl. A process running /usr/bin/python3 /srv/batch/export.py whose requests begin GET /health would match the suppression, and is never inspected, because no target selects it: approval is decided before plaintext is copied, and the suppression is evaluated after capture on records of approved instances only

name: configuration-only-pack
purpose: a pack that supplies no implementation and selects the built-in truncating-redactor for the operator's redact slot

name: external-component
purpose: an independently implementable external component declared with its input and output, state, ordering, lifecycle, version and failure results, placed after the built-in redactor, with the pack's claim approved by the operator and an enforceable ordering required
